desc:
🐴 Raise your very own race horse, from tiny foal to champion!

🍼 Pick your free foal and give it a name
🥕 Feed it, wash it and brush it so it grows up big and strong
🏇 Train at the Training Center to get faster, stronger and better at jumping
⭐ Teach your horse tricks at Trick School
🏁 Race in the Maiden Sprint, Steeplechase and Champion Derby
🏆 Win the race to stand in the Winner's Circle with a flower garland!
🎀 Show off your tricks and outfits at the Horse Show to win ribbons
💕 Breed foals, even with your friends' horses!
🏡 Adopt horses and get your own barn
🛍️ Shop the Superstore for saddles, hats and matching outfits for you AND your horse

👫 Make a private race just for you and your friends!
📜 Daily quests, daily gifts and surprise events like Carrot Rain and Double Coins

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to get updates!
👥 Join Jay Fire Studios for a free 250-coin gift!
